summary: Powell County site listed under Helena National Forest; a 1939 note says improvement was needed. No other source found and nothing on the site today.

events.note: Forest Lookouts records that the need for improvement at the site was shown in 1939. What, if anything, was done is not recorded in the sources read.

evidence.supports: Echo Mountain is in Powell County

evidence.quote: 1939: The need was shown for improvement of this site.

notes_for_editor: Thinnest of the three: one Forest Lookouts page with agency, survey code and a 1939 note. No build date, structure type, staffing or fate found. The story is about 60 words, below the 120-word floor, because nothing more could be sourced; recommend holding it for a Helena-Lewis and Clark NF or Powell County history check before publishing. Two web searches returned no Echo Mountain lookout in Montana. The cached FFLA Montana list has no Echo Mountain entry.
